definitions.accuracy: Pooled completions / attempts; never forced in the engine.
definitions.controlledPossessionShare: Carrier-only possession, comparable before and after.
definitions.reportedPossessionShare: New reporting includes intended pass flight, excluding missed-receiver loose balls and restarts. Baseline reported only carrier time.
definitions.conditions: Fixed real-club XIs, position fit at least .990, all tactic levels 3 and balanced except the designated weaker possession team. AI coaching disabled to isolate mechanics.
limitations: Small fixed sample, not a guarantee for every club or tactic.
S versus B passing is about 85% versus 81%, below the requested separation; possession B remains about 87%.
Expanded equal-S controls cover one mirrored XI; extra retention and chances raise goals, while observed shot conversion does not increase.

expandedEqualS.limits: Eight paired fixtures, four distinct seeds at two durations, one mirrored real XI; goals are noisy and this does not measure every team or formation.
